question: How do these behaviours differ across user segments?
summary: Observed from 10 retrieved chunks across app_store, blog, forum, play_store, social: Fit / size doubt after save, Other, Sizing runs small, Comparing saved items. Impact ranking uses share, source diversity, and severity — not star ratings. Implications below are hypotheses for Part 3 interviews, not conclusions.

sub_themes.name: Fit / size doubt after save
paraphrased_examples: Users describe fit / size doubt after save after liking or saving a Nykaa Fashion item — enough to stall a 30-day purchase.
sub_themes.hypothesis: Fit / size doubt after save may delay 30-day wishlist conversion.
interview_probes: When you saved something recently, did fit / size doubt after save come up?

implications: Observed: first-time vs repeat and category (ethnic/western/footwear) change the doubt. Hypothesis: segment-aware fit help on saved items would lift 30-day purchase unevenly — interview to confirm.
